changelog: [CHANGE] fx-jobs is now fx-lumberjack, rebuilt on the Fixitfy layout: c/ s/ framework/ ui/, config.lua, config_server.lua, locales.lua (en, tr).
[ADD] Target support: ox_target, murphy_interact or pc_interaction with Config.UseTarget; the prompt stays the default.
[ADD] fx-hud style progress bar with the axe icon, built into the resource.
[ADD] Discord logging for rewards and refused chops (config_server.lua).
[FIX] The reward event paid anyone who fired it. Every chop is now a server session checked for reach, tool and length.
[FIX] The axe requirement never ran; players without a lumberaxe could chop.
[FIX] Dying or walking away mid chop still paid out.
[FIX] A full bag lost the reward while the message said it was collected.
[FIX] RSG servers failed on start: vorp_progressbar was required.
[FIX] Blips piled up on every restart; zones, prompt and axe prop are now cleaned up on stop.
